text: Due to the lack of distinction in the continuity of the storehouse consciousness, the hypothesis that all are capable leads to the absurdity of the passage of time. Therefore, to establish the occasional nature of cognition, it must be understood that the six objects—sound, touch, form, taste, smell, and the objects of pleasure and so on—along with the four types of contact, give rise to the four types of perception, even for one who does not desire them, by the power of one’s own experience, and this must be delimited.
